title: The finite upper image is open
statement:
Let $X, Y \subseteq \bbr$, let $f : \bbr \to \bbr \to \bbr$ be a payoff function, and let $u$ be a finite sample of columns from $Y$. Then the finite upper image
\[
  U(X,f,u) \;=\; \{\, z : u \to \bbr \;\mid\; \exists\, x \in X,\ \forall y \in u,\ f(x,y) < z_y \,\}
\]
is an open subset of the space $u \to \bbr$ of vectors indexed by $u$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is a finite subset (sample) of columns from $Y$
replaced:
For every finite column sample $u$, the upper image $U(X,f,u)$ is an open subset
of $u \to \bbr$.
